description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git workflows involving pull requests. It sets up repositories, performs Git operations, and verifies the behavior of request-pull commands, including edge cases and formatting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.
